thread:
Eve (CS): Heads-up 1: multiple onboarding customers are reporting partial fails on webhook-based imports between 10:02-10:22 UTC. Some jobs show 200s but payloads were truncated. Need a short customer status, mitigation offer, and renewal-risk wording.

Leo - CS Ops: Can we classify severity quickly? I'd use: blocker (imports stopped), degraded (missing items), retryable (failed few batches). I'll make buckets.

Eve (CS): Uploaded buckets to #cs-ops-docs. Blockers: acct-bridge, acct-arc. Degraded: ~10 trials.

Harper (Support): Proposed remediation: blockers get immediate priority re-delivery + 2-week onboarding extension + 12% credit; degraded get expedited retry + 7% extension/credit. Offer a 1:1 troubleshooting call.

Ike (SRE): Initial root cause: recent HTTP client lib change introduced a header-limiting behavior that truncated large webhook bodies when chunked. Patch rolled at 10:18 UTC (restore previous lib config) and re-delivery queue started. Backfills in progress; ETA ~2-5 hrs depending on queue.

Marta (Product): For renewal-risk accounts we should assign a senior success lead and AM escalation. Billing pre-approves credits up to 15% under $5k MRR; AM approval above. Temp dedicated reingest throughput possible for critical accounts (ops + billing signoff needed).

Eve (CS): Draft customer line: "We apologize 1: an internal delivery issue caused some webhook imports to be incomplete. Engineering applied a fix and we are reprocessing affected imports. We'll prioritize the most impacted accounts and follow up with an ETA. Your success lead will contact you to coordinate next steps and any credits." Thoughts?

Leo - CS Ops: Add renewal-risk wording: "If this affects your contractual go-live, we'll escalate and provide tailored remediation and compensation; a senior success lead will be assigned." That's important for enterprise accounts.

Ike (SRE): Customer-facing FAQ blurb: "Cause: HTTP client header limit during chunked webhook delivery led to truncated payloads. Fix: reverted the header change, increased tolerance, and restarted re-delivery. Mitigations: add size validation, end-to-end webhook tests, and an alert on truncated payloads."

Harper (Support): Action: I need CSV columns (account, severity, owner, contact-email, MRR). Can we get that by 12:30pm PT? I'll run segmented sends and attach a 2-question pulse: 1) Did this block your go-live? 2) Want a troubleshooting session?

Eve (CS): Uploaded CSV to #cs-ops-docs. @Marta please confirm credit thresholds. @Ike post re-delivery progress in 30m.

Marta (Product): Confirmed billing pre-approval up to 15% < $5k MRR; AM approval needed above. If we spin up dedicated throughput tag billing@redwood.com and AMs for >$5k.

Ike (SRE): Progress 10:45 UTC 1: re-delivery processed ~40% of queued payloads; verification checks passing on processed items. New ETA ~2-3 hrs for current queue. Posting updates every 30 minutes to `webhook/replay` stream.

Leo - CS Ops: Drafting two templates (blocker + degraded) now, will share in #cs-review in 10m. Please review fast.

NotifyBot: Templates uploaded to #cs-review (link) 1: requesting signoff from @Eve, @Marta, @Ike.

Eve (CS): We'll include the short pulse and capture responses into the renewal-risk tracker. CC billing@redwood.com for credit approvals and loop AMs on any at-risk renewals. Sending after signoff.

Harper (Support): Standing by to monitor replies and escalate urgent asks to on-call success.

Ike (SRE): Postmortem ETA: EOD tomorrow with timeline, root cause, and action items (test coverage, deploy guard, payload-validation). Owners assigned.

Eve (CS): Thanks team 1: will post final send time and recipient list once templates are signed off.
